title: GNU Bash Environment Variable Command Injection (CVE-2014-6271)
text: CVE-2014-6271, Shellshock, is a vulnerability in GNU Bash's handling of specially crafted environment variables. Where an internet-facing service passes attacker-controlled data into a Bash environment, most notably CGI scripts but also some DHCP and mail processing paths, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can execute arbitrary shell commands. This combines exploitation of a public-facing application with direct command execution. The CVSS base score is 9.8 (Critical), and exploitation is trivial where a vulnerable CGI endpoint exists. Apply patched Bash packages immediately; note that the initial patch was incomplete and several follow-up CVEs were issued, so ensure all related updates are installed.
